label: First sit, right out of high school
punch_line: You paid almost nothing to sit right out of high school (cash outlay mid ≈ ₹0.2L). Your chance of an accessible MBBS seat your family can cash is 1.4% — not a rounding error of 0.01%, and still a brutal lottery.

label: Two drop years, still cannot afford private
punch_line: After ~2 years of studying, failed attempts, tutoring/lodging, and family opportunity cost (economic mid ≈ ₹9.7L; high coaching path ≈ ₹17.7L), your chance of an accessible seat your family can afford is still only 1.9% — a thin upgrade bought with years and money.

label: Two drop years, English + intensive + can pay private
punch_line: Same two-year ticket price in calendar time (economic mid ≈ ₹13.7L), but privilege raises accessible-seat chance to 7.9% — still a minority outcome, now with a privatized safety net.
